reviews.text: We recently moved to CT from Brooklyn but we came back to my Two Dogs to trim my APT’s nails. She gets very anxious and wriggles. Most technicians give up halfway but this place is so quick and efficient. The owners suggested we bring her fave treats and come first thing in the morning when it’s less chaotic. They also love on her which calms my dog during the trim. Was very quick service around 10 minutes. Great experience overall. Well worth the 1hr+ drive and will be coming back again soon.

For a business that states it “open” the door is ALWAYS locked. I’ve been trying to come in to ask some question to book a session but k can never get in. Even with a employee sitting at the front desk.

Annie and Gary are amazing. I love the patience they have with my Yorkie London. She has the worse anxiety after having a dental issue and My Two Dogs is the only groomers I trust with lil handful of joy.

this is my second time entrusting my puppy with them, and i continue to have such a great experience. they’re a sweet family-run grooming business who genuinely cares about the health and comfort of the dogs, not just the final look.

they’re very informative and take the time to answer any questions without any annoyance. they respond to emails quickly, are very transparent about what can and can’t be done, and they truly listen to both your concerns and your dog’s needs while working within safe limitations.

my pup came back clean, comfortable, and happy. highly recommend if you want groomers who truly care. 💗

The best dog groomer in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. My dog always comes home with a perfect and clean haircut. They really know how to take care of dogs. I highly recommend if you want a groomer that cares and does great work.
One of the best groomers in all of Brooklyn! My dog Yoshi was recommended to get groomed here by his bestie Arlo. They are such a kind team and worth the money.
Thanks so much Annie for a wonderful first visit. You were so caring and kind. Initially I was a bit hesitant, but I will definitely be back, thanks to you. Xoxo, Oliver ❤️

These guys are the best.  After I moved I tried going to other places, but they just didn’t do as good a job.  Now I schedule our cuts ahead of time and drive to bring my dog to them so she always looks super cute!

The BEST dog groomer in all of Brooklyn! We've been taking our Havanese here for 3+ years and can honestly say we have had only the best experience. The team is kind and caring. They are so gentle with our dog and make her feel like part of their family. Gary is our groomer and does a perfect job. Our dog looks beautiful and is never itchy or uncomfortable after her haircut.

We ONLY go to Gary and Annie to get our havanese's haircut. We used to have someone come to our apartment, but Gary is SO good and Annie ensures our little one is comfortable throughout the process. Our dog's haircuts look great from the second she leaves to the day we bring her back... we're so grateful for this place!

I used My Two Dogs for a virtual training session for my dog Gracie and I am so impressed! We spent some time talking about her current behaviors and habits, what my goals are for her, and discussed tactics and expectations for a timeline. The trainers were able to tailor our sessions to my apartment size and shape as well as by utilizing toys/tools I currently have. I was feeling overwhelmed when I picked her up, but even just one session had me feeling so much better about it!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Annie and Gary are the best! They take such great care of my bernedood and I always get compliments on his haircut after he’s groomed. You won’t be disappointed bringing your pup here!

Brought my dog to be groomed professionally for the first time after years of bathing him in the tub and using a hair dryer on him for an hour afterwards. Gary did a great job and he came back looking exactly like the picture I showed. Thank you so much! Can’t wait to bring him back.

We worked with Annie and Adamma through a private training package at home and it has changed our and our dog’s lives for the better! It was obvious that they care about their clients and put together thoughtful, personalized training plans for both of our dog’s specific needs. Our dog that has some reactivity is now comfortable in situations we could only dream of, and it came from a positive training experience.

I would  recommend them to anyone!!
